The '''Sabre Club''' was the most lavish and exclusive [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in the [[Ace of Sabres]]. It was limited to 999 members who had to pay 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a two-year membership. Each member got a [[Holocard/Legends|holocard]] that contained a genetic sample, voice print and retinal scan. It was also embossed with a counterfeit-proof [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] design. Entrance to the club was not permitted without this card.

The Sabre Club had a staff of [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] chefs which could prepare any meal that was requested. It also had a massive data library for use by patrons. The sitting room included all the modern conveniences. It had a 500-person main banquet hall and was decorated with antiques and artifacts from thousands of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. There was a long waiting list for membership.

It was managed by [[Gandin T'Noull]].
